# 📚 About

This repository contains my daily practice, assignments, notes, and projects completed during the **AI Udaan** program.

The purpose of this repository is to:

- Learn Python programming
- Practice Data Analysis
- Explore NumPy & Pandas
- Perform Data Cleaning
- Understand Statistics
- Prepare for Machine Learning
- Build a strong AI foundation

# 🚀 Learning Roadmap

- Variables

- Operators
- Conditional Statements
- Loops
- Functions
- Lists
- Tuples
- Sets
- Dictionaries

## NumPy

- Creating Arrays

- Broadcasting
- Mathematical Operations

---

## Pandas

- Series
- DataFrame
- Reading CSV Files
- Writing CSV Files
- Filtering
- Sorting

## Data Cleaning

Covered topics include:

- Missing Values
- Duplicate Records
- Incorrect Data Types
- Data Formatting
- Outlier Detection
- Outlier Treatment
- Feature Engineering Basics

---

## Outlier Detection

Methods learned:

- IQR Method
- Lower Bound
- Upper Bound
- Clip Method
- Median Replacement
- Standard Deviation
- Z-Score Method

---

## Statistics

- Mean
- Median
- Mode
- Variance
- Standard Deviation
- Percentiles
- Quartiles
- Correlation

---

## Data Visualization

Using:

Charts:

- Line Plot

- Histogram
- Pie Chart
- Scatter Plot
- Box Plot
- Heatmap

---

## Machine Learning Preparation

Topics include:

- Feature Scaling
